changelog: **Marketing pipeline stages follow the reader's language** (#2710). A MARKETING org is provisioned with the funnel's labels stored in English, and the read-side localizer only recognised the canonical keys — so a Turkish or German admin saw "New lead", "Proposal sent", … on the dashboard and boards. New `localizeResolvedStageLabels()` (`src/lib/programTemplates.ts`) extends the #2268 rule to every curated template stage: a stored label that is blank or matches our curated label in any locale reads back in the viewer's locale; a label the tenant typed stays verbatim. Used by `resolvePipelineStages()`, the client `useResolvedStages()` hook and the notification bell (`notificationText.ts` — a stage-change notification snapshots the label in the writer's locale, so "Stage changed: New lead → Proposal sent" reached Turkish readers too); no data migration needed. Unit-tested in `scripts/test/template-stage-labels.test.mjs`.

en: Sales pipeline stages — on the dashboard, the boards and in stage-change notifications — now appear in your own language instead of always in English.
tr: Satış hattındaki aşamalar — panoda, kanban tahtasında ve aşama değişikliği bildirimlerinde — artık her zaman İngilizce değil, kendi dilinizde görünüyor.
de: Die Phasen der Vertriebspipeline erscheinen jetzt – im Dashboard, auf den Boards und in Benachrichtigungen über Phasenwechsel – in Ihrer Sprache statt immer auf Englisch.
